scope: one seat/back; surface material only, no additional geometry slack

sources.reviewed: actual page: Spring Lux, Majestic, Feather Lux, Bliss Down and Relaxed Down seat/back descriptions
sources.finding: Seats combine polyurethane foam support with polyester wrapping and optional feather/down/fiber jackets; backs often use channelled polyester/microfiber or feather/down/fiber blends
sources.limit: manufacturer examples, not universal recipes or the owner's approved procurement specification

sources.reviewed: Sheen, Diffuse Roughness, Subsurface, Specular and Coat definitions
sources.finding: Sheen simulates microscopic surface fibers; it does not define filling hardness, elasticity or mechanical deformation
sources.limit: documentation gives parameter semantics, not universal cotton/foam presets; trial values require actual rendering

sources.finding: foam seat, linen/cotton cloth, down + fiber back/padding entries
sources.limit: no exact selected SKU or full filling section; do not infer foam firmness from density alone

sources.local_state: native Blender shader and complete 4K image set already used/tested in this project
sources.trial_use: retain native maps, physical UV scale and color; copy material to add a controlled microfiber sheen test

sources.reviewed: asset page description and 0.5m physical width
sources.decision: do not adopt: olive/khaki with dark-blue windowpane plaid conflicts with the chosen plain ivory/flax upholstery

physical_material_distinction.supportive_seat: foam core + softer wrapping/jacket; foam density alone is not its firmness specification
physical_material_distinction.softer_back: loose fiber/feather/down fill and shape-retaining channels; optional softer foam in other products
physical_material_distinction.visible_cover: linen/cotton or other upholstery fabric; this is the part controlled by a surface shader
physical_material_distinction.static_model_limit: changing a surface shader does not make the inner fill deform or create sagging/contact compression

trial.A: original native 4K linen; sheen weight0.2, sheen roughness0.5
trial.B: same material with sheen weight0.5 and sheen roughness0.8
trial.parameter_status: bounded renderer test, not measured material constants or a manufacturer-tested preset

visual_result: broader sheen changes brightness/reflection; no clear plush filling improvement
